title: Gandhi My Father
desc: The turbulent and troubled life of Gandhi's son, Harilal, who at once tried to support his father's ideology, while simultaneously trying to create a life for himself, separate from his family name.

title: Kya Kool Hain Hum 3
desc: A porn actor uses his fellow adult movie stars in creating a fake traditional family, in order to impress his girlfriend's conservative father.

title: Dil Toh Bachcha Hai Ji
desc: Three roommates are in search of true love. They each find a girl with whom they fall head over heels in love with. Now they just have to get the women to reciprocate.

title: Happy Ending
desc: Yudi is suffering from writer's block and his publishers decide to stop supporting him and instead publish the work of an Indian bestselling author. So, he must do something soon to maintain his fame.

title: Astitva
desc: The movie follows the story of Aditi, a devoted wife, who discovers her husband's infidelity. As she confronts her husband and delves deeper into the truth, she begins to question her own identity and place in society.
